health.professional_help: recommend a qualified clinician for diagnosis, emergencies, or treatment decisions
health.safety_note: Do not diagnose, replace emergency care, or give individualized treatment instructions without qualified oversight.

farming_chemicals.professional_help: recommend a qualified agronomist or local agricultural extension officer; follow the product label and local regulations
farming_chemicals.safety_note: Do not guess chemical dose, mixing, restricted-use status, pre-harvest interval, or protective equipment; require the exact product label and local approved guidance.

finance.professional_help: recommend a qualified, appropriately licensed financial professional for consequential decisions
finance.safety_note: Distinguish general education from personalized financial advice; disclose assumptions and material risks.

faith.professional_help: respect the user's tradition and recommend a trusted leader when pastoral guidance is requested
faith.safety_note: Identify tradition, translation, and interpretive differences; do not present one interpretation as universal.

education.professional_help: refer to the relevant teacher or official syllabus when curriculum-specific correctness matters
education.safety_note: Separate explanation from official syllabus requirements; preserve the learner's work and avoid fabricating references.

legal.professional_help: recommend a qualified lawyer or legal-aid service in the relevant jurisdiction for consequential decisions
legal.safety_note: Always establish jurisdiction and date; do not present general information as individualized legal representation.

evidence_source_policy_note: Host allowlists are a minimum filter, not proof that a specific page is accurate, current, unbiased, or jurisdiction-appropriate. Configure/review each domain allowlist and require human review for jurisdiction-dependent claims.
